# KUI

> KUI is copy-source Rust UI for GPUI (desktop + WASM). Button MVP. From Kense.

Product: KUI. Crate/CLI: `kui`. License: MIT.
Theme: pure black `#000000` / white `#ffffff` by default. Brand ink `#171717` only for important moments.

## For agents

- AI guide: https://kense.ai/kui/ai (local: /kui/ai)
- Install: `kui init` then `kui add button`
- Rules: repository AGENTS.md (Microsoft Pragmatic Rust Guidelines)
- Design: repository DESIGN.md
- Platforms: repository docs/PLATFORMS.md

## Items

- [kui-foundation](/md/kui-foundation.md): KUI foundation
- [button](/md/button.md): Button

## Registry JSON

- [/r/catalog.json](/r/catalog.json)
- [/r/button.json](/r/button.json)
- [/r/kui-foundation.json](/r/kui-foundation.json)

## Never

- Do not invent a second button package
- Do not rebrand away from KUI / kui
- Do not enable test-support on wasm32
- Do not paint everyday chrome with brand `#171717`
